_comment: Visual display constants. Edit freely to tune the look without touching code. See ui/knowledge.md for details on how each value is used.
_comment_target_fps: Render frame rate cap. Physics ticks are governed separately by gameplay.json ui.physics_tick_hz.

camera._comment: pixels_per_metre: zoom level. 9=1025x692 window, 12=1340x896, 14=1570x1032. margin_px: empty border around pitch. max_zoom/zoom_step: range and increment of the in-match ball-follow zoom control (the [-]/[+] control next to the sim-speed control, or Z to step) -- 1.0 is always the minimum (no zoom, whole pitch visible).

player._comment: min_radius_px: smallest on-screen circle radius drawn for a player. Physical world positions are unaffected — only the rendered dot size is boosted for visibility. possession_outline_thickness: pixel width of the white ring drawn around the ball carrier (1=thin, 3=bold). inactive_alpha: opacity (0-255) of a player drawn translucent after being tackled (0=invisible, 255=fully opaque).

ball._comment: min_radius_px: smallest on-screen circle radius drawn for the ball. outline: whether to draw a dark border around the ball circle. outline_width_px: pixel width of that border (1=thin, 3=bold). height_boost_per_metre: how much the drawn ball radius grows per metre of height (0=no growth, 0.35=original exaggerated, 0.1=subtle).

action_icons._comment: linger_s: wall-clock seconds an action icon stays visible above a player after the action fires. font_size_px: point size of the icon font — keep small (10-14) or they'll dominate the screen.

speed_lines._comment: threshold_mps: player ground speed above which trailing speed lines are drawn behind the player. count: number of parallel lines. length_px: length of each line in pixels. gap_px: spacing between successive lines.

stamina_flash._comment: threshold: stamina fraction (0-1) below which a flashing warning outline pulses around the player. flash_hz: flashes per second (wall-clock).

heading_indicator._comment: A broad, thin 'V' of two lines touching the player's circle at wide-spread points and meeting just ahead in the facing direction — not filled. length_px: how far the meeting point extends beyond the circle edge. base_half_width_px: half the spread between the two rim contact points (bigger = broader V). base_inset_px: how far inside the rim the contact points sit (0 = exactly on the rim). alpha: 0=invisible, 255=fully opaque. Set alpha to 0 to hide entirely.

kick_ui._comment: Kick trajectory preview and spin input constants. max_drag_m: mouse distance (metres) for full power — also scales elevation and spin sensitivity. trajectory_duration_s: seconds of trajectory shown. max_loft_angle_deg: elevation at closest mouse position. max_spin_magnitude_rads: spin at furthest mouse position.

pause_notification._comment: font_size_px: point size of the auto-pause banner rendered when a human order completes. Default title_font is 32; 26 = ~20% smaller.

ball_spin_dots._comment: Dots on the 3D ball surface (Fibonacci sphere), always shown, rotating with ball spin. Only front-hemisphere dots (facing camera) are drawn — back hemisphere is hidden. count: number of dots. projection_scale_fraction: how wide the projected sphere appears relative to ball drawn radius (1.0 = dots reach ball edge). dot_radius_fraction: dot radius / ball drawn radius. color: RGB.

ball_state_rings._comment: Coloured indicator rings drawn around the ball to show its state. offset_px: how far outside the ball circle the ring sits. width_px: ring line width. Set show_flying/show_rolling/show_bounced to false to hide individual rings. Colors are [R,G,B]. bounce_duration_s: how long the amber bounce ring stays visible after a bounce (also controls physics.json just_bounced_display_duration_s if you want them in sync — but this one only affects the renderer display; to change the underlying timer duration edit physics.json). flying_min_height_above_ground_m: margin above ball.radius_m at which the flying ring activates (0.01 = only genuinely airborne).

goal_net._comment: Diagonal mesh drawn inside each goal frame. spacing_m: gap between mesh lines in world metres (smaller = denser mesh). alpha: 0=invisible, 255=fully opaque. color: RGB.

ball_trail._comment: Fading ghost trail behind moving ball. length: number of ghost positions stored (sampled at physics rate). min_speed_mps: no trail below this ground speed. max_alpha: alpha of the newest ghost position. radius_fraction: ghost circle radius relative to ball drawn radius. radius_taper: how much the radius shrinks toward the oldest ghost (0=no shrink, 0.35=oldest is 35% smaller than newest, 1.0=oldest shrinks to nothing). interp_steps: sub-samples inserted between each stored position when drawing (1=no interpolation, 3=two extra sub-points per gap).

player_sprites._comment: Top-down player sprite (head/shoulders/torso/limbs) drawn instead of a plain circle. Set enabled=false to fall back to the old circle rendering. size_scale: sprite's on-screen diameter as a multiple of the old circle's radius_px (bigger = larger sprite relative to the pitch). Colours are RGB triples: skin/hair/shorts/shoe/lace/stud (team shirt colour itself is TEAM_LEFT_COLOUR/TEAM_RIGHT_COLOUR in ui/style.py, not here). hair_coverage_deg: how much of the head (in degrees, out of 360) the hair patch covers, centred on the back of the head — 0 = bald, 360 = fully covered. Finer body-shape proportions (torso/limb/shoulder sizing) are intentionally not exposed here — they were tuned as an interdependent set; see ui/player_sprites.py to go further. Animation: top_speed_for_stride_mps is the pace (m/s) at which a player hits max_stride_hz (full strides/second) and full stride extension; below that, both stride rate and how far the stride extends scale down (so jogging shows a shorter, slower stride, not just a slower one) — extension_speed_exponent > 1 makes that extension drop-off steeper at low-to-mid speed (only nearing full extension close to top speed), 1.0 = linear, < 1 reaches full extension sooner.
